faq.title: Rewards FAQ
faq.q1: How do I earn reward points?
faq.a1: You earn points by completing your candidate profile, completing eKYC verification, sharing job posts, and taking career quizzes.
faq.q2: Can I transfer points to another user?
faq.a2: Reward points are tied to your registered account and cannot be transferred or converted to direct cash.
